summary.text: Merlin Van Buren is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Rob Swearingen (R).
Van Buren is a member of the Rhinelander School District school board and ran for the same Assembly seat in 2010 and 2012.

paragraphs.text: Van Buren graduated from Waupun High School in 1978 and received a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin, Madison, in 1982.
He holds an at-large seat on the Rhinelander School District school board, with a term ending in 2029.
Van Buren was defeated by Republican Dan Meyer in the November 2010 general election for District 34.
In 2012 he won the Democratic primary over Roberta Retrum but lost the general election to Rob Swearingen, 36.2 percent to 57.2 percent.
Ballotpedia reports that Van Buren was removed from the ballot before the 2014 primary.
